## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Compatibility

State whether canonical bytes, accepted payloads, task fields, resource limits, package exports, or runtime support change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm audit`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] Valid, malformed, and limit cases were considered
- [ ] JSDoc and relevant Markdown were updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated
